verdict.rationale: Luma's Agents API is versioned: it has a /v1 base, returns an X-API-Version header on every response, and keeps a dated changelog that promises to announce breaking changes before they ship. The legacy-model migration guide also honors per-account deprecation notice periods. However, the FAQ sentence committing to a deprecation window was removed, callers cannot pin a version through the header, and the legacy Dream Machine generation is now bannered as legacy. missing for 10: a committed, fixed-length deprecation window or formal policy page, client-selectable version pinning, independent corroboration of deprecation handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Breaking changes are announced here before they ship.
If you received a deprecation notice, use the retirement date in that message as the cutoff for your account. Legacy requests will continue to work during the notice period.
